import numpy as np
d = np.load('/work/fwd/r3/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)

# Check L0H0 write properties
w = d['L0H0_ATTN']  # [4, 10, 56]

# Input 0: check write norms and value distribution
print("L0H0 write norms per position (input 0):")
for pos in range(10):
    n = np.linalg.norm(w[0, pos])
    print(f"  pos {pos}: norm={n:.4f}")

# Check if writes are continuous or near-binary
vals = w[0, 1:].flatten()
print(f"\nWrite value range: [{vals.min():.4f}, {vals.max():.4f}]")
print(f"Fraction near zero (<0.01): {np.mean(np.abs(vals)<0.01):.2%}")

# Also compare write at same position across different tokens (position-driven?)
# Input 2 (all-'a') vs input 3 (all-'z'), position 5
v_a5 = w[2, 5]
v_z5 = w[3, 5]
cos = np.dot(v_a5, v_z5) / (np.linalg.norm(v_a5)*np.linalg.norm(v_z5)+1e-8)
print(f"\ncos(all-'a' pos5, all-'z' pos5) = {cos:.4f}")
print("near 1 → position-driven; near -1 → token-driven")

import numpy as np
d = np.load('/work/fwd/r3/run.npz', allow_pickle=True)

# L0_MLP: check position vs token sensitivity
w = d['L0_MLP']  # [4, 10, 56]

# Same token 'a', different positions (input 2: all-'a')
v1 = w[2, 1]
v9 = w[2, 9]
cos_pos = np.dot(v1, v9) / (np.linalg.norm(v1)*np.linalg.norm(v9)+1e-8)
print(f"L0_MLP: cos(all-'a' pos1, all-'a' pos9) = {cos_pos:.4f}")
print("low = position-sensitive (MAPPER)")

# Same position, different tokens: pos 5 of all-'a' vs all-'z'
va5 = w[2, 5]
vz5 = w[3, 5]
cos_tok = np.dot(va5, vz5) / (np.linalg.norm(va5)*np.linalg.norm(vz5)+1e-8)
print(f"L0_MLP: cos(all-'a' pos5, all-'z' pos5) = {cos_tok:.4f}")
print("low = token-sensitive")

# Same for L1_MLP and L2_MLP
for name in ['L1_MLP', 'L2_MLP']:
    w2 = d[name]
    v1 = w2[2, 1]; v9 = w2[2, 9]
    cp = np.dot(v1,v9)/(np.linalg.norm(v1)*np.linalg.norm(v9)+1e-8)
    va = w2[2,5]; vz = w2[3,5]
    ct = np.dot(va,vz)/(np.linalg.norm(va)*np.linalg.norm(vz)+1e-8)
    print(f"\n{name}: cos(same_tok diff_pos)={cp:.4f}, cos(same_pos diff_tok)={ct:.4f}")
